why: Prepare the current GitHub plugin-bundle route without creating a portal entry or changing the production MCP contract.

pageOrSourceBlocker.reason: The current developer portal takes a repository, plugin folder, tracked branch or tag, data-handling answers and compliance acknowledgments.

fields.name: tracked branch
fields.reason: Prepare the local release ref after checks; remote publication needs the owner go.

fields.name: publisher account and GitHub push access
fields.reason: Paid individual plans can submit without an organization role. Confirm the long-term owning account and its connected GitHub repository access.

fields.name: developer portal
fields.reason: Use Submit new → Plugin bundle only after the source ref is available remotely.

fields.name: listing and data handling
fields.reason: Review submission/anthropic/README.md and the answers file against the actual portal questions.

fields.name: compliance acknowledgments
fields.reason: The publisher reviews and accepts the actual four acknowledgments in the portal.

fields.name: Claude.ai and Claude Code OAuth acceptance
fields.reason: Local validation is not authenticated client evidence.

fields.name: separate remote MCP connector
fields.reason: The first-party remote server needs its own connector entry. Preserve the current OpenAI-reviewed runtime contract until the owner schedules that work.

result.claim: The local Anthropic preparation is not evidence of directory validation, client acceptance or public availability.

recovery: Complete authenticated Claude tests, publish the source ref with owner authorization, validate that commit in the developer portal, review private access and compliance, and obtain separate authorization for the final send.
format: internal-preparation-map; not an Anthropic upload schema
